review_candidates.title: Country Lead
review_candidates.description: Reports to : Chief Operating Officer (COO), Company Department : Country Operations Location : Based at company's Dubai (DIFC) headquarters — candidates must be willing to relocate to and live in Dubai. Periodic travel to the assigned country (DRC / Ethiopia / Haiti), as required Employment Type : Full-time Openings : Three (3) — one Country Lead each for DRC, Ethiopia, and Haiti ABOUT COMPANY : Company is a DIFC-registered climate finance and ecosystem restoration developer building and financing nature-based and community-centred projects across the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, and Haiti. Company structures carbon and restoration projects in partnership with local ground partners, governments, and communities, and mobilises capital to deliver measurable environmental and social impact. ROLE PURPOSE : The Country Lead is Company's dedicated point of accountability for the assigned country, based at Company's Dubai headquarters and driving day-to-day project execution with the country's ground partner(s), relevant government bodies, and other local stakeholders — while keeping Company's Chief Operating Officer fully informed through structured, timely reporting. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who gets things done meticulously: the Country Lead is expected to organise large, complex, multi-stakeholder projects and drive them to completion, to present high-quality work to senior and demanding audiences, and to bring enough financial and project-development fluency — including comfort with basic modelling — to sense-check budgets, timelines, and deliverables coming from the field. Periodic travel to the assigned country may be required to maintain relationships in person. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES : — Project ownership & execution — own the country workplan end-to-end: break large, complex projects into clear workstreams, sequence dependencies, track milestones and open items meticulously, and drive them to completion. — Ground partner coordination — act as the primary liaison between Company and the country's ground partner(s), ensuring workplans, deliverables, and timelines stay on track. — Government & regulatory liaison — build and maintain working relationships with relevant ministries, regulatory bodies, and local authorities, engaging foreign government counterparts with diplomacy and tact; track permits, approvals, land tenure, and other regulatory requirements specific to the country. — Correspondence management — own the day-to-day correspondence for the country — emails, calls, meeting notes, and follow-ups with all parties — and keep a clear record of open items and commitments. — Reporting to the COO — provide the COO with structured, regular updates (status, risks, blockers, decisions needed) and escalate issues promptly rather than letting them surface late. — High-quality deliverables & presentations — prepare and present polished briefings, memos, and presentations for government counterparts, partners, investors, and Company leadership — accurate, well-structured work that stands up in front of demanding audiences. — Project development support — support pre-feasibility and feasibility work, monitor project timelines and milestones, and help translate field realities into planning documents Company can act on. — Financial oversight — track in-country budgets against actuals, flag variances, and support the COO and finance function with cost data, vendor invoicing checks, and basic financial reporting; maintain and update simple models (budgets, scenarios, project economics) as needed. — Ground team leadership — run the country's stakeholder engagement team on the ground and manage the ground-level project leads and teams, ensuring their work meets Company's standards and stays on plan. — Contract & compliance support — support drafting and monitoring of contracts and agreements with ground partners and local vendors, in coordination with Company's legal and commercial functions. — Representation — represent Company at local meetings, government engagements, and community events as required. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE : — Master's degree in a relevant field — international development, public policy, business administration, finance, environmental/natural resource management, or similar — is preferred but not required; a strong record of delivery matters more than credentials. — Meaningful professional experience in project development, international development, government relations, or a related field, ideally including time in-country or in a comparable operating environment, with a track record of organising large, complex projects and driving them to completion. — Prior exposure to climate finance, carbon markets, infrastructure, or ecosystem restoration projects is a strong advantage — but not a requirement; Company hires for execution ability first. — Working knowledge of financial concepts — budgeting, budget-to-actual tracking, cost analysis — and comfort building and using rudimentary models (e.g. in Excel), sufficient to engage credibly with Company's finance and project development teams. — Demonstrated experience dealing directly with government bodies, regulators, or multilateral/development institutions — this is essential. — Demonstrated experience presenting high-quality work — written and spoken — to complex, senior stakeholders such as government officials, boards, or investors. — Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing multiple stakeholders, and working independently with limited direct supervision. — Willingness to be based in Dubai and to travel periodically to the assigned country for field engagement, as required. LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS : — French — Fluent French, both spoken and written, is mandatory for the DRC and Haiti roles — the Country Lead must be able to draft correspondence, reports, and hold meetings in French without support. French is not required for the Ethiopia role. — English — Professional fluency in English is mandatory for all three roles — required for reporting to the COO and coordination with Company headquarters. — Local language — Working knowledge of a relevant local language (e.g. Lingala/Swahili for DRC, Amharic for Ethiopia, Haitian Creole for Haiti) is a strong advantage. CORE COMPETENCIES : — Structured, precise communicator — able to write a clear, professional update under time pressure. — Trustworthy custodian of sensitive relationships with government and community stakeholders. — Diplomatic — exercises tact, discretion, and cultural sensitivity when engaging foreign government officials and senior stakeholders. — Financially literate and comfortable with numbers, without needing to be a finance specialist. — Driven and meticulous — an organised self-starter who follows through on open items without needing to be chased. — Calm under pressure when field issues, delays, or stakeholder friction arise. WHAT COMPANY OFFERS : A competitive, market-benchmarked salary and benefits package, direct exposure to Company's leadership and project development process, and the opportunity to build a country program from the ground up within a fast-growing climate finance platform. HOW TO APPLY : Interested candidates should submit a CV and a short cover note (in French or English) outlining relevant experience and language proficiency to   dropcv@omegaphigroup.com later than September 30,2026 , indicating the country of interest in the subject line.

review_candidates.title: Architect
review_candidates.description: Role Description We are looking for a forward-thinking and technically strong Architect to define and guide the architecture of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. In this role, you will translate business and technical requirements into effective architectural strategies and ensure that solutions align with organizational goals, technical standards, and long-term product direction. You will design high-level solution architectures, evaluate technologies and technical approaches, and establish architectural principles, patterns, and standards. You will work closely with product, engineering, security, and business stakeholders to understand complex requirements, identify technical risks, and make informed architectural decisions. The role involves reviewing solution designs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring consistency across systems and platforms. You will also contribute to technical roadmaps, architecture documentation, technology evaluations, and the resolution of complex technical challenges. You will promote scalability, performance, security, resilience, and maintainability throughout the solution lifecycle. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Strong understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, and modern development methodologies. Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical architectures. Strong knowledge of system design, integration patterns, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, and distributed systems. Understanding of security, performance, scalability, availability, and reliability considerations in architectural design. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and make sound decisions. Ability to create clear architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and solution specifications. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and provide technical direction. Familiarity with modern cloud platforms, DevOps practices, microservices, and containerization is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Account Executive - MEA
review_candidates.description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. On a daily basis, you will Generate new leads and opportunities within an assigned territory, leading to closing business enabling you to exceed your revenue targets quarterly and yearly. Manage prospecting sales efforts to target key accounts and work with the channel partners to generate a pipeline in your territory. Use multi-channel strategy to engage with your prospects (Linked-In, email, videos, cold calls, meetings, etc.) and execute them to convert identified prospects into new logos. Take ownership of your book of business: document the buying criteria, the buying process, the next steps and owners, and ensure pipeline accuracy based on evidence. Size and quote customer software license needs. Interact with prospects over phone, email, video conference, and on-site meetings when necessary. Support marketing efforts with account-based customer-focused marketing campaigns. Proactively engage in building, growing, and sharing sales team best practices. Accurately capture and report all aspects of account and opportunity information within the SFDC platform. Utilize Salesforce.com to set daily activity and accurately forecast opportunity pipeline. The Skills You Will Demonstrate Proven successful 3-4+ years of experience in a B2B sales role, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model. Focus on building and managing customer relationships. Experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer. Proven expertise in territory planning and prospecting, using various channels and tools for prospecting, such as Zoominfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn, calling, and networking. Expertise in navigating and growing a pipeline in prospect accounts and taking a deal from Lead Qualification to Closed Won. Familiarity in supporting and selling to mid market customers and managing and negotiating (> 20k USD) deals. Ability to drive the sales process effectively through phone calls, emails, and virtual and on-site meetings. Proficiency in communicating with executive-level contacts and delivering value messages based on the persona you are engaging with (bottom/up and top/down approach) Salesforce.com expertise; you know it and can’t imagine sales without it. Customer-Centric focus; We Want Happy Customers. Written and spoken English at a professional level. The Soft Skills You Will Demonstrate Strong communication and listening skills: handling objections and taking feedback and coaching. Team player interested in seeing the company goals achieved alongside the team and individual goals. Self-driven, desire to succeed, hungry and proactive attitude. Nice to have Experience in Software Development Tooling sales or experience selling into the Development side of IT. Experience with selling and closing deals internationally. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at [email protected] . All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
